name: android-screen
description: Lets Claude see and drive an Android device: screenshots, a compact view hierarchy with tap points, input and app control, plus a live device mirror pane.

package.title: Application id
package.description: The app's applicationId for /relaunch and the app tool. Left empty, it is read from the app module's build.gradle(.kts).

mirrorIntervalMs.title: Mirror refresh interval (ms)
mirrorIntervalMs.description: How often the device mirror pane takes a new screenshot while it is shown. Only with $.process; through the Bash tool the mirror refreshes on demand.
